name: Trattoria & Pizzeria "Da Rocco"
kurzbeschreibung: **Da Rocco** – Your authentic Italian trattoria and pizzeria in **Innsbruck** Indulge in the warm, rustic charm of **Tirol** with every bite at **Da Rocco**, where traditional Italian flavors meet Alpine hospitality. From hand-tossed pizzas to hearty pasta dishes, our menu celebrates the simple, bold tastes of Italy—just like Nonna used to make. **Why you’ll love it:** ✔ **Fresh & seasonal** – Ingredients sourced from local farms and artisanal producers. ✔ **Homestyle cooking** – Dishes like **Spaghetti alla Carbonara**, **Risotto alla Milanese**, and **Tiramisu** made with love. ✔ **Cozy atmosphere** – A welcoming space to unwind after a day exploring **Innsbruck**’s streets or the stunning **Tiroler Alpen**. ✔ **Perfect for all** – Whether you’re craving a quick **Pizza Margherita** or a leisurely **7-course tasting menu**, we’ve got you covered. **Must-try dishes:** 🍕 **Pizza Classica** – Classic **Marinara** or **Diavola** with a crispy crust. 🍝 **Gnocchi al Pomodoro** – Pillowy potato dumplings in a rich tomato sauce. 🍷 **House wine & craft beer** – Pair your meal with our carefully selected **Wein** or local **Bier** from **Tirol**. **Location:** 📍 Right in the heart of **Innsbruck**, just a stone’s throw from the **Goldenes Dachl** and **Hofburg**. **Opening hours:** 🕒 Mon–Thu: 12:00–23:00 | Fri–Sat: 12:00–00:00 | Sun: 11:00–22:00 **Reservations recommended** – Especially for weekends and special occasions! Come taste the sun of Italy in the heart of **Tirol**—**Da Rocco** awaits! 🍝✨ --- *Book a table* *View menu*
